limitations: Source-reported accuracy is not a certificate of absolute geographicaccuracy for the whole app.
Geographic observations and accepted line positions do not establish unmeasured dimensions.
Registration and modification timestamps are database events, not independently known measurement dates.
Tree observations must remain separate from LiDAR crown observations unless identity is reviewed.
Existing ditch matches are candidate correspondences using whole-source vertexdistances; no source line replaces an OSM network automatically.
All projectedsource coordinates stay only in evidence. Runtime integration must copy explicit local geometry and scalar metadata.
